name: smwgraphics-alternate-redrawn-muncher
title: Alternate Redrawn Muncher
description:
Alternate Redrawn graphics for the Muncher/Black Piranha Plant pseudo-enemy, now looking actually black to fit-in its more modern name.

While it's meant to replace the original Muncher's graphics, files for the plants having four animation frames like in Super Mario Bros 3 are also included.

name: smwgraphics-brambles
title: Brambles
description:
Brambles I made for my QLDC 2021 level, Curse of the Keys. They're GBA/DS styled-ish and blend well with my other tilesets. Since they only take 1 slot I would suggest mixing them with the wood/bridge tiles from my Radished Cliffside set.

Note that the sloped tiles are set to act like normal slopes (the upside-down ones as tileset-specifics). They need some kind of patch (Like This UberASM) or custom block to achieve the effect.

name: smwgraphics-calling-all-mixels-inspired-cragster-land
title: Calling All Mixels-inspired Cragster Land
description:
This is my first time posting an sunset BG and FG I've made myself, and as you can see, this is a redraw of the Cragster Land, based on Calling All Mixels. I've decided to make this a sunset because in the original game, the Electroid Land takes place at night, since it was a disco land of some sort. I've used an isometric perspective on the L3 BG, not only because it looks aesthetically pleasing, but also, and most importantly, to save storage space for the L3 BG

NOTICE: If you want to use the L3 BG, make sure to use a patch to get rid of the status bar.

versions.title: Calling All Mixels-inspired Cragster Land

name: smwgraphics-calling-all-mixels-inspired-infernite-land
title: Calling All Mixels-inspired Infernite Land
description:
Does anyone remember LEGO Mixels? Well, I've made some graphics of the 1st world in Calling All Mixels, the Infernites Land. In this game, each tribe's land has been re-imagined specifically for that game, like how the Infernites Land has been re-imagined as a tropical vacation resort with burning hot lava instead of water, since the Infernites themselves are fire-resistant and go swim and bathe there.

Huge thanks to HaruMKT for helping me with managing the palettes' colors, I struggle a lot with managing colors, and luckily, they came in to help me, so, thanks again!

versions.title: Calling All Mixels-inspired Infernite Land

name: smwgraphics-castlevania-aria-of-sorrow-dance-hall-basement-boss-room
title: Castlevania: Aria of Sorrow - Dance Hall ~ Basement (Boss Room)
description:
Wine stored in old barrels seen during the boss fight against the Giant Golem, from Castlevania: Aria of Sorrow. Compared to the source material, I had to be quite creative in how to loop the background, since the Game Boy Advance resolution is smaller. A good fit for wine cellars, in general.

Please do credit me if you use this submission, since it took me a lot of effort to assemble this graphic and make it look consistently good. Thanks!

The tower-like tileset seen in the final level of Castlevania: Dracula X, where Richter has to dodge medusa heads and spear knights, while riding flying platforms. It uses the last colors of palette 4, while keeping the graphics from cement and note blocks intact.

A good fit for tower (vertical) levels.

In addition to the graphics, the .zip comes with a custom palette for a purple Ninji skin, akin to the enemy's appearance in SMAS:SMB2. Required to set the sprites' palette through STEAR/Tweaker/PIXI's CFG Editor from palette C to palette F for the color change to take effect.

Additional information in the readme file. Credit is optional, but appreciated.

name: smwgraphics-doraemon

description:
The underwater marine life, seen in one of the rooms of the Ancient Ruins, from Doraemon 3 for the Super Famicom. The source material uses wave HDMA, but maybe you can use parallax scrolling to move the fishes.

Since it is a really tall background, it uses one of the expanded horizontal level modes. To change it, click in the Mario head icon in Lunar Magic and put Horizontal Level Mode to the value you'd like.

A good fit for underwater or bonus levels.

description:
The 2nd dungeon's tasty BG and FG from DoReMi Fantasy, you can use this for a sweets-themed stage (obviously), or you could just use the starry night sky BG for something else (even if I don't know how to animate palettes yet, since in the original game the BG palette was animated). name: smwgraphics-forest-jungle

description:
Foreground started earlier on in the year as a request in The Rip Lair, finished as of today thanks to the assistance of Moltz (conversions to .bin, drawing of the climbable vines, decor grass on dirt fill, bush decor, flowers for bushes, brambles, non-slanted vines on logs is his contributions. The water is palette animated. It benefits a lot from parallax scrolling in certain parts.

You can extend the river easily, if you don't like the perspective of the background.

A good fit for mountain or forest themed levels.

name: smwgraphics-hatsune-miku
title: Hatsune Miku
description:
“I can see at the end of the horizon — HATSUNE MIKU?!”

You heard that right — the most famous Vocaloid of all has arrived to Super Mario World! Featuring all of the poses included in the game, as well as for the overworld. In addition, it has several color schemes, such as Player 2 Miku having Akita Neru's palette, and Fire Miku palettes being based on Sakura and Snow Miku color schemes.

Please note that, due to the way SMW graphics limitations work, all of her graphics are HEAVILY EDITED to compensate with player graphics (and color palette even!) limitations. A future update will include support for 32x32 Tilemap Patch, which allows more dynamic movements and poses.

Credit goes to Kryz70phoro for making the graphics (You can check out the spritesheet here!) and ported by yours truly for ROM hacking usage.

versions.title: Hatsune Miku

name: smwgraphics-sonic-mania-stardust-speedway-zone-act
title: Sonic Mania - Stardust Speedway Zone (Act 1)
description:
Here's the BG and FG of Stardust Speedway Zone, I had to take some creative liberties with the Layer 3 BG because I don't think I can fit that many tiles in one file, and I don't want to sacrifice the global LG storage for this. I had to reduce the amount of colors in the palettes of the FG and the L3 BG, also, I had to reshade some of the FG tiles to appear more "smooth" to give off the illusion that it has more color, like in the original tileset.

A huge thank you to Random Talking Bush from the TSR moderation team for letting me and everyone else use this BG and FG tileset, go check out their original submission and their profile, and make sure to credit them for originally ripping these assets for everyone to use!

NOTICE: I'd highly recommend to apply a patch to remove the layer 3 statusbar to make space for layer 3 BG's

versions.title: Sonic Mania - Stardust Speedway Zone (Act 1)
